cues: Step four, the Bessemer converter, lined with silica.
A hot air blast removes the last iron as slag and turns some copper sulphide into copper oxide.
Then the oxide and sulphide react together: two copper one oxide plus copper one sulphide give six copper and sulphur dioxide.
No outside reducing agent at all.
This is auto reduction, or self reduction.
